task: Full custom UI/HUD/menu art pass, all wired in-game, for Concrete Dragon
resume_brief: CUSTOM UI ROUND 2 for Concrete Dragon (~/workspace/ConcreteDragon). Owner directive: full custom UI and HUDs, all custom art and menu art HOOKED UP and working in the game — not assets sitting in a folder. Round 1 (PR #17, merged) did: Saira Stencil One font, damage ghost bars, combo pop, KO glow. Round 2 goes further: (1) CUSTOM HUD REDESIGN — health bars, energy meter, combo counter, boss HP bars, score display: fully custom-styled, cohesive, wired into gameplay. (2) MENU ART — title screen, character select, pause menu: custom backgrounds/panels/frames in the game's blocky-fighter style, wired in. (3) CUSTOM UI ELEMENTS — buttons, panels, banners, popups, all styled to match. Everything must be IN the game and functional. Free-first: Kenney UI packs, game-icons.net (CC BY, credited), OFL fonts. Strictly the game's existing visual style. Use a dedicated worktree: git worktree add ~/workspace/ConcreteDragon-art-ui-2 art-ui-2. Branch art-ui-2 -> PR -> merge (never direct to main). Heartbeat ~/workspace/agent-ops/checkpoints/cd-art-ui-2.json after every step; incremental commits. Verify with playtests + captures of EVERY screen touched, your own eyes. Obvious-defect checklist every playtest.
